body.en:
Start with a situation

A crane holds a load, a trolley accelerates and a metal rod stretches. Each situation needs a different mechanics model.

Definition

Mechanics studies forces and their effects on bodies. Applied mechanics uses these principles to analyse engineering situations.

Understand the reason

Statics studies equilibrium. Dynamics studies motion:kinematics describes motion without considering its causes; kinetics relates motion to forces and mass.

Example / application

A stationary suspended load is a statics problem; accelerating a trolley needs dynamics; stretching a rod also needs deformation analysis.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A real object may need different models for external equilibrium and internal deformation.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

Crane load પકડી રાખે,trolley accelerate થાય અને rod ખેંચાય—દરેક માટે જુદું mechanics model જોઈએ.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Mechanics bodies પરના forces અને તેની અસરોનો અભ્યાસ છે.Applied mechanics આ સિદ્ધાંતો engineering situationsમાં વાપરે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Statics equilibriumનો અભ્યાસ કરે.Dynamics motionનો અભ્યાસ કરે:kinematics કારણ લીધા વગર motion વર્ણવે;kinetics motionને forces,mass સાથે જોડે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Stationary suspended load statics છે;accelerating trolley dynamics છે;rodના stretch માટે deformation analysis પણ જોઈએ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

એ જ real object માટે external equilibrium અને internal deformationનાં models જુદાં હોઈ શકે.

h.en: 1.1.2 Space, time, mass and body idealisations

body.en:
Definition

Space locates position; time orders events; mass measures inertia and is not the same as weight. Weight is gravitational force W=mg.

A particle has mass but negligible dimensions for the problem. A rigid body is idealised as having unchanged distances between its points. A flexible/deformable body changes shape under loading.

Example / application

A hook may be a particle for concurrent cable equilibrium; a beam needs a rigid-body model to study support moments; its deflection needs a deformable-body model.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Rigid is an assumption, not a claim that real steel never deforms.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Space position બતાવે;time eventsનો ક્રમ બતાવે;mass inertiaનું માપ છે,weight નહિ.Weight gravitational force છે:W=mg.

Particleમાં mass હોય,પણ problem માટે dimensions અવગણાય.Rigid bodyના pointsનાં અંતર બદલાતાં નથી એવું idealise કરીએ.Flexible/deformable body loadથી shape બદલે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Cable equilibriumમાં hook particle બને;support moments માટે beam rigid body બને;deflection માટે deformable-body model જોઈએ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Rigid એક assumption છે;real steel ક્યારેય deform નથી થતું એવો દાવો નહિ.

body.en:
Definition

A scalar needs magnitude and unit(e.g.mass, time, energy).A vector also needs direction(e.g.force, displacement, velocity).

The seven SI base units are metre(m), kilogram(kg), second(s), ampere(A), kelvin(K), mole(mol) and candela(cd).Length, mass and time dominate elementary mechanics.

Derived units include velocity m/s, acceleration m/s², force N=kg·m/s², stress Pa=N/m², moment N·m and energy J=N·m.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Moment and energy share dimensions but represent different physical quantities. Use N·m for moment, not an energy interpretation.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Scalar માટે magnitude,unit જોઈએ(જેમ mass,time,energy).Vectorમાં direction પણ જોઈએ(જેમ force,displacement,velocity).

સાત SI base units:metre(m),kilogram(kg),second(s),ampere(A),kelvin(K),mole(mol),candela(cd).Elementary mechanicsમાં length,mass,time મુખ્ય છે.

Derived unitsમાં velocity m/s,acceleration m/s²,force N=kg·m/s²,stress Pa=N/m²,moment N·m,energy J=N·m આવે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Moment,energyની dimensions સરખી છે પણ physical quantities જુદી છે.Moment માટે N·m લખો,energyનો અર્થ નહિ.

body.en:
Given

Mass50 kg; assumeg9.81m/s².Surface area200 mm² carries an axial force10 kN.

Stepwise solution

  1. W=mg=50×9.81=490.5 N
  2. 10 kN=10000 N; stress=10000/200=50 N/mm²=50 MPa

Remember / avoid this mistake

1 N/mm²=1 MPa; 1 mm²=10^-6m².Never mix kN withmm² and silently label the result Pa.

Quick check: Does50 kg mean50 N?

No. Mass and weight differ; weight depends ong.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Mass50kg;g9.81m/s² માનો.Surface area200mm² પર axial force10kN છે.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. W=mg=50×9.81=490.5N
  2. 10kN=10000N;stress=10000/200=50N/mm²=50MPa

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

1N/mm²=1MPa;1mm²=10^-6m².kN અને mm² ભેળવી resultને ચૂપચાપ Pa ન લખો.

જાતે વિચારો: 50kg એટલે50N?

ના.Mass,weight જુદાં છે;weight g પર આધારિત છે.

body.en:
Definition

A force is a vector interaction capable of changing motion or causing deformation. Its description needs magnitude, direction, sense, line of action and point of application.

Understand the reason

Represent it by a directed segment whose scaled length gives magnitude and arrow gives sense. The line extended through it is the line of action.

External force can cause translation, rotation or both; internal stress/deformation depends on how loading is introduced.

Example / application

A100 N pull through a door hinge and the same100 N far from it have different turning effects. The moment magnitude about a point is force×perpendicular distance.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A moment arm is perpendicular distance to the force line, not automatically the distance to the arrow tip.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Force motion બદલી કે deformation કરી શકે એવો vector interaction છે.તે માટે magnitude,direction,sense,line of action,point of application જોઈએ.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Directed segmentની scaled length magnitude અને arrow sense આપે.તેને લંબાવેલી line line of action છે.

External force translation,rotation કે બન્ને કરે;internal stress/deformation loading કઈ રીતે આવે તેના પર આધારિત છે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Door hingeમાંથી100N pull અને hingeથી દૂર એ જ100Nની turning effect જુદી છે.Point વિશે moment magnitude=force×perpendicular distance.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Moment arm force lineનું perpendicular distance છે,arrow tipનું distance જરૂરી નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Label the spaces around a force diagram by letters. A force separating spacesa andb is namedab; the correspondingly directed segment in a force polygon represents that force.

Stepwise solution

  1. Choose an ordered lettering around the force diagram.
  2. Identify the two spaces on either side of each force line.
  3. Construct the corresponding force-polygon segment to scale in the required direction; keep the traversal convention consistent.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Letters alone do not determine sign; arrow direction and the adopted polygon order must agree.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Force diagramની આસપાસના spacesને letters આપો.Spaces a,b વચ્ચેના forceનું નામ ab;force polygonમાં યોગ્ય directed segment તે force દર્શાવે.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Force diagramમાં ordered lettering લો.
  2. દરેક force lineની બન્ને બાજુનાં spaces ઓળખો.
  3. જરૂરી directionમાં scaled force-polygon segment દોરો;traversal convention સતત રાખો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

ફક્ત lettersથી sign નક્કી નહિ થાય;arrow direction અને polygon order મળવા જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

For external equilibrium of a rigid body, a force may be moved along its own line of action without changing its external effect. This is the principle of transmissibility.

Forces acting together have a combined vector effect equal to their vector sum. Superposition of deformations additionally needs linear behaviour and appropriate unchanged boundary conditions.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Do not move a force to a parallel different line without adding the equivalent couple; transmissibility does not preserve every internal stress field.

Quick check: Can transmissibility justify any sideways shift?

No. Only along its original line for the stated rigid-body external effect.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Rigid bodyના external equilibriumમાં forceને પોતાની line of action પર ખસેડવાથી external effect બદલાતી નથી.આ principle of transmissibility છે.

સાથે લાગતા forcesની combined vector effect તેમના vector sum જેટલી છે.Deformationsની superposition માટે linear behaviour અને યોગ્ય unchanged boundary conditions પણ જોઈએ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Equivalent couple ઉમેર્યા વગર forceને બીજી parallel line પર ન ખસેડો;transmissibility દરેક internal stress field જાળવતી નથી.

જાતે વિચારો: Transmissibilityથી Forceને બાજુમાં ગમે ત્યાં ખસેડી શકાય?

ના.ફક્ત original line પર,આપેલી rigid-body external effect માટે.

h.gu: 1.1.8 Solve કરતાં પહેલાં Force System ઓળખો

body.en:
Definition

Collinear forces share a line. Coplanar forces lie in one plane; non-coplanar forces do not. Concurrent force lines meet at one point. Parallel forces have parallel lines; general non-concurrent forces need not meet or be parallel.

A couple consists of equal, opposite, parallel forces on separate lines. It has zero resultant force but nonzero moment Fd.

Example / application

Cable tensions meeting at a ring:concurrent. Beam vertical loads:parallel. Forces on a general bracket:non-concurrent.

Build an exam answer

  1. Define each class, draw force lines, show whether they share a plane/point, and give one application before selecting equations.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Collinear forces એક line પર હોય.Coplanar એક planeમાં;non-coplanar એક planeમાં નહિ.Concurrent force lines એક point પર મળે.Parallelની lines parallel હોય;general non-concurrent એક point પર ન મળે અને parallel હોવી જરૂરી નહિ.

Coupleમાં અલગ lines પર equal,opposite,parallel forces હોય.Resultant force zero,પણ moment Fd nonzero હોય.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Ring પર મળતાં cable tensions:concurrent.Beamના vertical loads:parallel.General bracketનાં forces:non-concurrent.

પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. દરેક class define કરો,force lines દોરો,plane/point common છે કે નહિ બતાવો અને equations પહેલાં એક application આપો.
